stories.headline: The market says a Fed rate hike is a done deal. Here's why it might hold steady.
Inflation is outpacing wage growth again, squeezing Americans’ paychecks
stories.summary: In August, consumer prices rose 3.4% over the past year while wages increased just 3.1%.
